description: This file defines the JournalState class, managing the application's journal entries' state, including loading, updating, deleting, filtering, and maintaining entries, with interaction with storage service.

classes.name: JournalState
classes.description: A state management class extending ChangeNotifier for handling journal entries, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and initialization.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads journal entries from storage, sorts them, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: addOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new journal entry or updates an existing one, then sorts and saves to storage.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a journal entry by ID, updates storage, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setSearch
methods.description: Updates the search query string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setSelectedTags
methods.description: Sets the selected tags filter and notifies listeners.

methods.name: allTags
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of all unique tags from journal entries.

methods.name: filteredEntries
methods.description: Returns entries filtered by current search query and selected tags.

methods.name: _sort
methods.description: Sorts journal entries by date in descending order.

methods.name: newBlankEntry
methods.description: Creates and returns a new blank journal entry with a generated UUID and current date.
